# Homebrew Tap (Bonjoski)

> Official Homebrew tap for the Bonjoski sovereign AI agent security toolchain (Fabrial, Airlock, Aegisbox, Argus, Shield, Conjoiner, Stormcage, Soulcaster, Bomhound).

## Core Capabilities
- Automated Homebrew Distribution: Distributes pre-compiled multi-arch bottles (ARM64 / x86_64) for macOS and Linux.
- Codesigned Entitlement Packaging: Preserves macOS Secure Enclave and Hypervisor entitlements.
- Automated Release Bumping: Integrated with GoReleaser artifacts and GitHub Actions.

## Usage
- `brew tap bonjoski/tap`: Adds the official repository tap.
- `brew install bonjoski/tap/<tool>`: Installs target security tool.
- `brew upgrade bonjoski/tap/<tool>`: Upgrades to latest release bottle.

## Formula Catalog
- `fabrial`: Dynamic multi-tier security fabric router.
- `airlock`: Tier 1 kernel process sandbox (<15ms).
- `aegisbox`: Tier 2 microVM hardware isolation sandbox.
- `argus`: Pre-flight slopsquatting interceptor.
- `shield`: Client-side secret redactor and fail-closed wire guard.
- `conjoiner`: NIST SP 800-207A agentic IAM broker.
- `stormcage`: Cross-agent context memory firewall.
- `soulcaster`: Runtime compiler attestation (SLSA v1.0).
- `bomhound`: CycloneDX legal attribution engine.
